response.sql: WITH line_totals AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total_cost, COUNT(*) AS expense_count FROM expense WHERE link_to_budget IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_budget), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS avg_total FROM line_totals) SELECT AVG(lt.total_cost) AS avg_above_average_total, COALESCE(SUM(lt.expense_count), 0) AS total_expense_count, AVG(lt.total_cost - b.avg_total) AS avg_excess FROM line_totals AS lt CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE lt.total_cost > b.avg_total;
